name: dotagent
description: A small agent workflow: plan, atomic slices, review, PR, CI, merge by permission level.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: small (commit and PR directly), medium (plan, atomic commits, one PR), or large (plan document, Haiku per slice, reviewer)

merge.title: Merge level
merge.description: off (the agent never merges), on-green (after review and green CI), or full

em_dash.title: Em dash
em_dash.description: block (refuse em dashes in written text) or allow

style_skills.title: Style skills
style_skills.description: Comma separated skills to invoke at the start of a run, for example caveman,ponytail:lite, or none
